activities.title: Gym
activities.description: Early riser or evening mover? Make time for yourself and recharge with a workout that fits your day.
activities.alt: The sunlit gym at Club Med Opio with cardio and strength equipment

activities.title: Tennis
activities.description: A good rally, a little friendly competition, and a great way to spend time together. See you on court.
activities.alt: Tennis players getting ready for a rally

activities.title: Padel
activities.description: Grab a partner and get into the game. Quick rallies, shared laughs, and team spirit come naturally on the padel court.
activities.alt: A group enjoying padel with a Club Med G.O

activities.title: Golf
activities.description: Step away from the everyday and into the green. Enjoy a few swings, fresh air, and a moment to focus on your next shot.

activities.title: Pétanque
activities.tagline: A little Provence. A lot of fun.
activities.description: A classic game with a relaxed spirit. Gather your colleagues, take your best shot, and enjoy the pleasure of simply being together.

activities.title: Stretching
activities.description: Let the day slow down. Join your Fitness G.O for a gentle stretching session and leave feeling ready for the evening ahead.
